import json, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace")
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp/work")
from public_check import run_candidate
from harness import gw, BASE, req

CAND = "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"

def cli(batch):
    data = json.dumps(batch).encode()
    out = run_candidate(__import__("pathlib").Path(CAND), data)
    return json.loads(out.decode())

def inproc(batch):
    return gw.process(json.loads(json.dumps(batch)))

cases = []
# empty jobs
cases.append({"directory": {}, "accounts": {}, "gateways": {}, "jobs": []})
# base batch
cases.append(json.loads(json.dumps(BASE)) | {"jobs": []})
L = {"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"}
P = {"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}
b = json.loads(json.dumps(BASE))
b["jobs"] = [
  {"gateway":"edge","ingress":L,"trusted_out":True,"raw":req(body="x"*30000)},
  {"gateway":"inside","ingress":P,"trusted_out":False,"source":0},
  {"gateway":"inside","ingress":P,"trusted_out":True,"source":1},
]
cases.append(b)
# 2048 jobs
b2 = json.loads(json.dumps(BASE))
b2["jobs"] = [{"gateway":"edge","ingress":L,"trusted_out":True,"raw":req(callid="c%d"%i)} for i in range(2048)]
cases.append(b2)

for i, batch in enumerate(cases):
    a = cli(batch); c = inproc(batch)
    same = json.dumps(a, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(c, sort_keys=True)
    print("case", i, "jobs", len(batch["jobs"]), "match", same, "statuses",
          {r["status"] for r in a["results"]}, "bytes", len(json.dumps(a)))
    assert same
print("CLI OK")
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp/work && time python3 t_cli.py
